efficiency_estimates.notes: MFU is the retained mixed-arithmetic useful-FLOP estimate; MBU is expected model weight plus 16-bit KV traffic divided by H200 4.8 TB/s. These are resource-model estimates, not hardware counters or guaranteed remaining speedups. Dense FP8 peak is 1,979 TFLOP/s and 16-bit peak is 989.5 TFLOP/s. The same reference model normalizes all three runtimes; native engine and HTTP delivery overhead differ.
